artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person. The person is in a front-facing position, with the body slightly turned to the side. They have long, curly hair that cascades past the shoulders and frames their face. The facial features include a straight nose, full lips, and eyes that gaze slightly to the side. The person is dressed in ornate clothing, featuring a lace collar and a garment that includes armor on one shoulder. The background is a simple, textured oval space, within which the person is contained. There is a decorative border with inscriptions surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Sion
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a cluster of buildings viewed from above, showcasing varying architectural designs, balconies, and windows with people visible. The drawing uses fine pencil strokes to emphasize details, with a monochromatic grey palette highlighting textures and street activity. People are depicted in the scene going about their daily activities, adding a dynamic element. The composition invites viewers to explore the intricate details of the alleyways and building facades.

artworks.title: Jason
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The print displays a natural setting filled with fallen trees and leaves. Closest to us, to the right of center, a person is climbing over a large fallen tree trunk. The person faces away from us, and they are wearing armor and a helmet. They look out over the tree trunk toward an arch that is visible in the center of the print. The arch appears to be too small to be a bridge, and its purpose or function is unclear. In the bottom right corner, behind the person, the skeleton of a large animal is visible. The rest of the background is a jumble of tree limbs, leaves, and shadows, with a large hill reaching up in the top right. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Jason
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Charles Turner
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a knight in armor sitting on a fallen tree. The knight is on the right side, looking at a coiled dragon in thick foliage. The background is filled with sloping terrain and dense vegetation, creating a sense of being surrounded by nature. The artwork is detailed with intricate etching of leaves, bark, and dragon scales. The color scheme is monochromatic, using various shades of brown for contrast. In the lower left corner, there are skeleton remains, adding an ominous tone to the scene.

artworks.title: The Bridge in Middle Distance
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image features an aerial view of a landscape with a high horizon line. An arched bridge or aqueduct spans the scene, leading towards distant hills or mountains under a clear sky. The artwork is rendered in fine lines resembling an etching technique, detailing trees and foliage. The color scheme is monochrome, with warm paper tones and dark ink strokes creating contrast. Figures are depicted sitting under tall trees, with a mix of natural and architectural elements in the background. The scene conveys a serene and open atmosphere with detailed natural elements.

artworks.title: The Bridge in Middle Distance
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Charles Turner
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: This image shows a pastoral landscape with a wide expanse of land seen from an elevated point. The horizon is high in the composition. In the distance, a bridge with several arches spans a river. The brushstrokes capture the texture of the foliage with a light touch. The color palette consists of sepia tones. Three figures are seated on the ground, appearing to be engaged in conversation. Tall, slender trees frame the view. Soft clouds are scattered across the sky in the background.

artworks.title: Junction of Severn and Wye
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a valley stretching into the distance. The horizon line is near the top third of the image. The etching shows fine lines and delicate shading to convey texture and depth. There are rolling hills with trees in the foreground, a reclining figure on the left, and hills leading to distant formations that may be mountains or flat lands. Tall trees frame the right side, with foliage rendered in intricate lines, and distant shapes resembling buildings or ruins. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark lines contrasting the light tone of the paper.

artworks.title: Junction of Severn and Wye
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene seen from an elevated point. The horizon stretches across the center of the composition with distant landforms meeting a calm expanse of water or sky. The brushstrokes exhibit a detailed and meticulous technique, conveying textures of trees and foliage. The color palette is a warm sepia tone. Closest to us, a figure is seated on the ground surrounded by trees and shrubs. Remnants of structures can be seen to the right, partially hidden among trees.

artworks.title: Scene in the Campagna
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with natural and architectural elements. The horizon line divides the composition, with distant hills and an ancient temple-like structure visible. Trees are depicted on the left and right, with one tree dominating the right side. In the middle, a figure is depicted working on the ground, while others walk near arches. The scene features a range of light and dark tones with a sepia color palette, creating a serene quality.

artworks.title: Scene in the Campagna
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and William Say
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image is captured in a sepia tone, providing an aged appearance. The point of view suggests a perspective on a path looking over a natural setting. A person is bent over, working on or examining a sculptural piece or architectural element. Tall trees frame the view on both sides. In the middle ground, there are shrubs leading to an ancient structure with columns and arches on the horizon line. The brushstrokes are detailed, especially with the texture of the trees and sky. The color palette is warm with shades of brown, creating a harmonious visual impact.

artworks.title: Hedging and Ditching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a detailed scene. The horizon is high, obscured by a line of trees. Trees dominate the scene, with a flock of sheep in the distance. A large, gnarled tree is on the left with intricate details. Dark lines and cross-hatching provide texture. On the right, figures are engaged in various activities. The color palette is monochromatic, using brown ink to enhance details.

artworks.title: Hedging and Ditching
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and J.C. Easling
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: This image is sepia-toned and viewed from an elevated position, showing a landscape with people engaged in various activities. Some individuals are working near a large tree, while others are tending to a fence. The horizon is depicted high in the image, with trees in the distance. The cloudy sky is above. The print medium obscures brushstrokes, but the natural elements are detailed and textured. The color palette is warm brown, evoking a vintage feel. Trees in the distance add to the pastoral atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mill near the Grand Chartreuse
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky, forested landscape viewed from slightly above ground level. There is a subtle line where the dense foliage and cliffs begin to recede, creating a natural border. In the distance, a bridge spans between the cliffs. The brushstrokes are fine lines and hatch marks adding texture to rocks and trees. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The rocks and trees in the foreground are detailed, with lines for bark and surface texture. The landscape becomes less detailed towards the bridge and distant trees.

artworks.title: Mill near the Grand Chartreuse
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Henry Edward Dawe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from a vantage point within a heavily wooded area, looking towards a rugged mountainous backdrop. The horizon is partially obscured by the cliffs and trees, creating a sense of depth as it recedes into the valley. The scene features an old bridge spanning across the chasm in the distance, with a small building nestled beside it. The technique used in the image suggests finely detailed, intricate brushstrokes and engraving styles that emphasize textures of the rocks, foliage, and flowing water. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia tones, casting a nostalgic and serene atmosphere over the landscape. The trees close to us frame the composition, leading the eye toward the dramatic interplay of light and shadow across the terrain beyond.

artworks.title: Isleworth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a calm body of water, likely a river or pond, viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is high in the composition, obscured by trees and an ancient structure. Lush trees with detailed leaves and shading are on the right, leading to grass and reflective water. In the distance on the left, a round temple with columns is reflected in the water. The sky and distant architectural elements are sketched with minimal detail. The style features fine linework and cross-hatching, with a monochromatic color palette of sepia-like tones.

artworks.title: Isleworth
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Henry Edward Dawe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient architecture, tree-lined pathways, and a body of water reflecting trees. The scene is depicted in a sepia tone, with detailed brushstrokes for the trees and classical columns. The sky has wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Aesacus and Hesperie
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed line drawing of thick, intricate trees with abundant foliage and twisting branches filling the frame. There is no distinct horizon line visible, as the tree branches dominate the composition, creating a canopy effect. The illustration features fine, delicate strokes capturing the textures of the leaves and branches. The color scheme is mainly light tans and browns. In the background, a person is seated on the ground, while another figure is partially hidden by foliage, both appearing small compared to the trees.

artworks.title: Aesacus and Hesperie
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a densely wooded area with a water feature flowing through it. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the forest setting with tall trees, branches forming a lush canopy, and a stream flowing over rocks. A seated figure is seen in a clearing, with another figure further into the scene. The composition is detailed with fine brushstrokes depicting leaves, rocks, and water realistically. The color palette consists of rich sepia tones. Light and shadow play on the landscape, enhancing its details.

artworks.title: Isis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The drawing captures a landscape scene with architectural elements. In the distance, there are trees and hills. Close by, there are detailed depictions of plant life and structures. The drawing features intricate line work defining the foliage and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic with fine lines and subtle shading in sepia or a soft brown tone.

artworks.title: Isis
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and William Say
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a horizon near the center of the composition. Distant hills with rolling terrain are visible under a sky filled with swirling clouds. A large bridge with arches appears on the horizon, and lush foliage and various plants are in the foreground. A bird is perched on a fallen architectural piece. In the background, a classical rotunda is partly hidden by dense trees, suggesting a cultivated setting. The artwork features soft, intricate brush-like strokes blending the elements together. The color palette is warm with sepia tones, creating an antique aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Woman of Samaria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural elements and figures. The view is from a slightly elevated point, showcasing various structures, including an archway and a tower-like building in the distance. The painting features minimal brushstrokes, emphasizing fine outlines and detailed foliage and stonework. The color scheme is monochromatic, using brown tones on a light background, enhancing the linework and shadows. Two figures are near stone blocks, while another pair walks along a curved path. Trees cluster on the right side, with more architectural forms and landscapes in the background, creating depth.

artworks.title: The Woman of Samaria
artworks.artist: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Samuel William Reynolds I
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a gentle upward slope from right to left. In the foreground, two figures are seated on stone blocks, conversing, with one holding a jug. Nearby, there is an archway with two figures walking towards each other. Architectural ruins are scattered in the distance against the sky. The scene is depicted in sepia tones with soft brushstrokes, creating an aged appearance. The sky features swirling cloud patterns.

artworks.title: The Long Gallery, Louvre
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art gallery interior. The drawing shows a spacious gallery hall with an arched ceiling, high walls adorned with framed artwork, and several figures moving or standing around. The sketchy lines convey movement and volume, creating a soft and atmospheric view of the space. The perspective is directed towards an archway at the end of the gallery where more figures can be observed.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This print shows two figures in an outdoor setting. In the center, a woman sits or kneels on grass, wearing a long dress with a low neckline and draped sleeves. Her curly hair is partially styled into an updo, with some stands falling around her face and down her back. She looks downward at the man who sits at her feet. He has a full, white beard and curly hair, a handful of which he holds up in one hand. The woman holds a pair of shears to the strands of hair, appearing to cut them. Part of his hair has already been cut short. The man is wearing a ruffled tunic with thin trousers and sturdy boots. He looks down at the ground. On the ground in the bottom left corner, there is a bottle, cup, and stacked plates with food scraps and a small knife. In the top left is a brick wall with an arched opening, and on the right are some tall, leafy trees in front of a cloudy sky.
